subject: Pricing for compliance add-ons (audit logs, HSM, data residency)
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@medsys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medsys.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing for compliance add-ons (audit logs, HSM, data residency)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — Medsys is evaluating Redwood for several internal AI features. Procurement asked me to get a firm pricing line for the compliance add-ons so we can complete our internal TCO. Specifically we need: audit logs (retain raw events for up to 7 years), KMS/HSM-backed key-management for model inference, and EU data residency (primary region EU-West-1).

Estimated steady-state usage: ~25M tokens/month, with 3 heavy teams that need HSM seats (approx 3 seats). We may start smaller in month 1 and ramp to that over 3 months. Two short asks:
- Can you provide tiered pricing for audit logs (per-GB or per-event), and HSM (per-seat vs per-request)?
- Can you invoice in EUR (we need to pay in EUR to our EU entity) or provide a hedged exchange-rate option?

Attached is our compliance checklist and a short PO template. Timeline: procurement hopes to have pricing and a PO by 5/10.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-minute call if helpful.

Erin Walsh
Senior Procurement Manager
Medsys Health
Attachments: Medsys_compliance_requirements.pdf, Medsys_PO_4321.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@medsys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing for compliance add-ons (audit logs, HSM, data residency)

Hi Erin — thanks for the checklist and the clear usage estimate. High level we can support all three items; below is a compact proposal and I attached a spreadsheet that breaks numbers out by band.

Proposal (initial):
- Audit logs: baseline retention tier (90 days) included; long-term retention charged as $0.09 per GB-month beyond included 50GB. Export / event-query cost: $0.003 per 1k events.
- KMS / HSM: two billing options: per-seat annual (recommended for predictable access) at $9,000/seat/year (includes HSM-backed keys and rotation ops), or per-request model at $0.008 per HSM-call.
- Data residency (EU): flat region surcharge of $3,500/month for a dedicated regional footprint with customer isolation + audit log replication to EU.

Discounts / credits we can offer: 10% off compliance add-ons for a 12-month committed spend on Redwood core + addons (volume thresholds in spreadsheet). We can also apply one-time onboarding credit to offset audit-log ingestion costs.

About EUR invoicing: we can invoice in EUR, but there are two general approaches: (A) Redwood invoices in USD and Medsys pays in EUR at the invoice date FX rate, or (B) Redwood issues EUR invoices and we add a small FX fee to cover hedging — we need to align on which GF entity will sign and whether tax/VAT will apply. Monica from Finance is looped to confirm the hedging options and the final credit math.

If useful I can provide two small alternative quotes in the spreadsheet: 1) per-seat heavy HSM model, 2) per-request HSM model.

Next step: quick 20-min call with procurement + finance to lock the invoice currency and commit threshold. Are you available 5/6 or 5/7 late morning PST?

Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-compliance-pricing-v1.xlsx, redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@medsys.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing for compliance add-ons (audit logs, HSM, data residency)

Hi Erin — thanks, quick clarifying note from finance on discount mechanics and credit allocation.

Two pragmatic options we typically give enterprise procurement:
1) Commitment model (recommended): 12-month committed ARR on total Redwood spend (core + addons). For commits >= $250k ARR, we apply a 15% discount to compliance add-ons and provide a one-time onboarding credit equal to 4 weeks of audit-log ingestion. Residency surcharge waived for first month.
2) Short-term trial: 6-month commit with 10% discount and a capped onboarding credit.

Credit allocation: the onboarding credit can be split between audit logs and HSM seat setup. We suggest allocating 60% to ingestion (audit logs) and 40% to HSM onboarding unless you prefer otherwise.

Currency treatment: if you need EUR invoices we can do a billed-EUR option and lock a mid-market FX rate for the quarter with a 1.5% administrative spread. This avoids re-billing volatility for both sides. VAT handling will depend on where Medsys entity is domiciled.

I'll update the spreadsheet to show the two options side-by-side and include sample invoice lines.

Monica Patel
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@medsys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medsys.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing for compliance add-ons (audit logs, HSM, data residency)

Karthik / Monica — thanks for the options. A few quick responses from procurement:

- Medsys prefers the commitment model (12-month) to keep vendor overhead low.
- We will ask for a 20% discount on compliance add-ons in year one to offset migration costs — is there flexibility to meet 20% for the first 12 months if we commit to $300k ARR?
- For EUR invoicing: we would like Redwood to invoice in EUR and lock the quarterly rate; the 1.5% spread is acceptable. We will confirm VAT treatment after our legal review.

If you can get a 20% first-year discount for compliance add-ons (audit logs + HSM seats + residency fee) and provide updated invoice lines by EOD 5/7, procurement can route an internal approval and finalize a PO. Also: please include a short DocuSign-ready SLA + SOW to attach to the PO.

I attached the PO template earlier but can re-send if needed.

Erin
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@medsys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing for compliance add-ons (audit logs, HSM, data residency)

Hi Erin — Stephanie from Finance here. Appreciate the clarity and the scale. We ran the numbers and can propose a compromise that meets procurement timeline: 

Final commercial proposal (for PO):
- 12-month commitment at $300k ARR (core + addons combined)
- Compliance add-ons (audit logs + HSM seats + residency): 15% discount off list for the first 12 months, plus a one-time onboarding credit (applies as Monica suggested: 60% ingestion / 40% HSM setup).
- EUR invoicing: Redwood will invoice in EUR and lock the FX rate for the quarter; administrative spread = 1.5%. VAT shown separately.
- Residency surcharge: waived for first 30 days; then $3,500/month.

We cannot carry a 20% discount across the full addon line at $300k ARR, but to bridge the gap we will:
- Provide an additional one-time credit equal to 5% of the year-1 compliance addon spend (applies after billing).
- Fast-track priority onboarding (two-week SLA for audit-log ingestion support).

Next steps: Karthik will send an updated quote + DocuSign SLA and the PO template you provided. Once we have a signed PO / DocuSign return we’ll schedule onboarding.

If that sounds acceptable, please confirm and we will route the DocuSign.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: updated_quote_medsyspack_v2.pdf (will be attached to DocuSign)
From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@medsys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medsys.com
Date: Sat, 9 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing for compliance add-ons (audit logs, HSM, data residency)

Thanks all — confirmed. Medsys will proceed with the 12-month $300k ARR commitment under the terms below:
- 15% year-1 discount on compliance add-ons + one-time credit (60/40 split)
- EUR invoicing with quarter-locked FX rate and 1.5% spread
- Residency surcharge waived first 30 days

Please send the DocuSign packet and the updated invoice lines so legal can attach the DocuSign SLA to our PO. We expect to return a signed DocuSign within 48 hours after receiving the packet.

Attached: Medsys_PO_4321.pdf (PO placeholder)

Erin Walsh
Senior Procurement Manager
Medsys Health
Attachments: Medsys_PO_4321.pdf
